name: Wardrobe 1100 (zhitov drawing)
comment: From the zhitov.com drawing: 1100 x 600 x 2460, 18 mm board, in U156 ST9 Pjescano bez. Built as two carcasses like the hall wardrobe: a lower drawer carcass (bottom on six 100 mm legs, 314 sides and partition, full-width top at 432..450, HDF back) and an upper carcass standing on it (bottom at 450..468, 1974 sides, partition to the top shelf at 2024, top at 2442..2460, HDF back), joined by four screws down through the upper bottom. Interior 2324 overall as on the drawing; the drawing labels read 512 but 523 + 18 + 523 = 1064, the inner width it also gives. Right column: four adjustable 570-deep shelves on 5 mm pins with two spare holes above and below each (32 mm pitch, none where a shelf would hit a hinge plate); left column: hanging rail. Two drawers in the lower carcass: fronts 344 in the door plane (103..447), boxes 497 x 570 x 250 in white board on 6 mm HDF bottoms, on 550 roller runners. Doors 545 and 543 from 451 to 2457 (right one 2 narrower for a 5 mm gap to the end panel). Top filler 65 flush with the doors on a flat 55 x 18 backer screwed to the top on the bench, glued and doweled; full-height end panel 2525 x 618 on the exposed right side; plinth clipped to the front legs; 3 mm HDF backs over the rear faces (boards 597 deep, 600 overall). Fasteners are modelled as hardware parts (not cut): confirmat 7x50 at every fixed carcass joint (caps 2 mm proud where visible, flush where covered), 4x30 wood screws for the stacking, end panel, backer and drawer fronts, 8x30 dowels for the filler, staples for the HDF. Hinges (cup, arm, plate) and handles are drawn by the viewer.

assembly.title: Lower carcass: bottom
assembly.note: Start with the bottom panel of the drawer carcass, front edge forward.

assembly.title: Legs
assembly.note: Screw the six adjustable legs to its underside: three along the front edge, three along the back, the middle pair under the partition line. Wind them to 100 mm.

assembly.title: Lower carcass: left side
assembly.note: Stand the left side (314 tall) on the bottom, flush at the front, three confirmats from below through the bottom.

assembly.title: Lower carcass: right side
assembly.note: Same for the right side: three confirmats from below.

assembly.title: Lower carcass: partition
assembly.note: The short partition 523 from the left side, three confirmats from below.

assembly.title: Lower carcass: top
assembly.note: Lay the full-width top over the sides and the partition and fix it from above: three confirmats into each side and three into the partition, heads flush, the upper carcass will sit on them.

assembly.title: Lower carcass: back
assembly.note: Square it and staple the lower HDF back over the rear faces of bottom, sides, partition and top.

assembly.title: Upper carcass: bottom
assembly.note: On the bench, start the upper carcass with its bottom panel.

assembly.title: Upper carcass: left side
assembly.note: Stand the left side (1974 tall) on it, three confirmats from below through the bottom, heads flush.

assembly.title: Upper carcass: right side
assembly.note: Same for the right side.

assembly.title: Upper carcass: partition
assembly.note: The partition 523 from the left side, up to where the top shelf will sit, three confirmats from below.

assembly.title: Upper carcass: top shelf
assembly.note: The full-width shelf 400 under the top: three confirmats through each side and three down into the partition.

assembly.title: Upper carcass: top
assembly.note: Lay the top over the sides and fix it from above with three confirmats into each side.

assembly.title: Upper carcass: back
assembly.note: Square it and staple the upper HDF back over the rear faces of bottom, sides, partition, top shelf and top.

assembly.title: Filler backer
assembly.note: Still on the bench: screw the flat backer strip down onto the top along its front edge, five screws 27 in from the edge.

assembly.title: Stack the upper carcass
assembly.note: Lift the upper carcass onto the lower one, flush at the front and both sides, and screw it down from inside: four screws through its bottom into the lower top.

assembly.title: Plinth
assembly.note: Clip the plinth to the three front legs.

assembly.title: Rail holders
assembly.note: Screw the two rail holders to the left side and the partition, 74 under the top shelf.

assembly.title: Hanging rail
assembly.note: Drop the rail into the holders.

assembly.title: Shelf pins
assembly.note: Push four pins into the chosen holes for each adjustable shelf.

assembly.title: Adjustable shelves
assembly.note: Lay the four adjustable shelves on their pins.

assembly.title: Left drawer: box sides and ends
assembly.note: On the bench: the two sides stand outside the front and back pieces, two confirmats per corner through the sides, heads flush on the outside so the runners clear them.

assembly.title: Left drawer: bottom
assembly.note: Square the box and staple the 6 mm HDF bottom under it.

assembly.title: Left drawer: runner, drawer part
assembly.note: Screw the drawer profile of each runner along the bottom edge of the box sides, wheel at the back, flush with the box front.

assembly.title: Left drawer: runner, cabinet part
assembly.note: In the lower carcass: screw the cabinet profile of each runner to the compartment faces, flat on the bottom panel, wheel at the front, flush with the carcass front.

assembly.title: Left drawer: slide in
assembly.note: Lift the box, tilt it so the drawer wheels pass over the cabinet wheels, and roll it in. Check it runs freely.

assembly.title: Left drawer: front
assembly.note: Hold the front against the box, aligned with the doors above (3 at the wall, 4 between, 5 at the end panel), and screw it on from inside the box with four screws.

assembly.title: Right drawer
assembly.note: Same as the left drawer: build the box on the bench, fit the drawer runner profiles, screw the cabinet profiles into the right compartment, roll the box in and screw the front on from inside.

assembly.title: Left door
assembly.note: Screw the hinge plates to the left side, press the cups into the door and clip it on. 3 at the wall, 4 to the drawer front below.

assembly.title: Right door
assembly.note: Same on the right side. 4 to the left door, 5 to the end panel.

assembly.title: Stand up and end panel
assembly.note: Stand the wardrobe in the corner and level it on the legs. Scribe the end panel to floor and ceiling if needed, then screw it on from inside the right column through the side, six screws.

assembly.title: Top filler
assembly.note: Scribe the filler to the ceiling, then glue and dowel it onto the backer front edge, flush with the doors.
